title: Riesz representation with a Borel unit field on a σ-compact locally compact Hausdorff space
statement: Let X be a Hausdorff, locally compact, σ-compact topological space with its Borel σ-algebra, N ∈ ℕ, and L : C_c(X; ℝ^N) → ℝ an ℝ-linear map such that for every compact K ⊆ X there is C ∈ ℝ with L(f) ≤ C for every f ∈ C_c(X; ℝ^N) with |f(x)| ≤ 1 for all x ∈ X and tsupport f ⊆ K. Then there are a Borel measure μ on X with μ(K) < ∞ for every compact K ⊆ X and a strongly measurable ν : X → ℝ^N with |ν(x)| = 1 for μ-a.e. x and L(f) = ∫_X ⟨f(x), ν(x)⟩ dμ(x) for every f ∈ C_c(X; ℝ^N).
lean_statement: ∀ (X : Type) [TopologicalSpace X] [T2Space X] [LocallyCompactSpace X] [SigmaCompactSpace X] [MeasurableSpace X] [BorelSpace X] (N : ℕ) (L : C_c(X, Rn N) →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ), (∀ K : Set X, IsCompact K → ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ f : C_c(X, Rn N), (∀ x, ‖f x‖ ≤ 1) → tsupport f ⊆ K → L f ≤ C) → ∃ (μ : Measure X) (ν : X → Rn N), (∀ K : Set X, IsCompact K → μ K < ∞) ∧ StronglyMeasurable ν ∧ (∀ᵐ x ∂μ, ‖ν x‖ = 1) ∧ ∀ f : C_c(X, Rn N), L f = ∫ x, inner ℝ (f x) (ν x) ∂μ
